title: 周末的一天

explanations.4: Aspect particle indicating completion of an action (ate).
explanations.5: Measure word for pieces of bread or similar items.
explanations.6: Measure word for cups of liquid.
explanations.8: Conjunction used in alternative questions (bread or egg?).
explanations.9: Common measure word for nouns like bread.

explanations.15: Question pronoun asking for information about something.
explanations.16: Indefinite quantifier meaning a number of things.

translation: Today is Sunday. In the morning I get up at seven, first go to the bathroom, then eat breakfast. I ate a piece of bread and drank a cup of milk. Mom asked me: "Did you eat bread or egg?" I said: "I ate a bread." At nine o'clock in the morning, I went to the supermarket with mom. The supermarket has many people. Mom asked: "What are we buying?" I said: "We are buying some fruits and vegetables." Mom bought three apples and two eggs. I didn't buy books, I also bought a notebook; this notebook is very good. At noon we go home to cook, I can help mom wash vegetables. Dad is reading in the room. At two in the afternoon we go outside to play. Outside is in front of home. Outside has many flowers. We sit on chairs, dad runs with me, my little sister can dance, she dances happily. We had a very happy time. At five in the afternoon we go home, eat dinner in the evening. Dinner has fish, rice and eggs. We are all very happy. Next time we come again to play, I am not tired.
